title: LARP – Revenue infrastructure for serious founders
summary: LARP is a revenue infrastructure platform designed for startup founders to build, manage, and scale their revenue operations more effectively, providing tools and infrastructure to handle the complexities of growing a business's revenue streams.
problem_solved: Provides founders with unified revenue infrastructure to streamline sales, billing, and financial operations without building custom solutions from scratch.
why_valuable: Enables startups to focus on growth rather than building revenue systems, offering enterprise-grade revenue infrastructure at a fraction of the cost and complexity.
